classification.difficultyReason: Compare the cost of the same quantity under two purchase options and calculate the saving.

content.prompt: The cost of 20 packets of chips is $\$9.50$, while each packet costs 65 cents when sold individually. If you want to buy 40 packets of chips, which option is cheaper? How much do you save by taking the cheaper option?

answer.short: Buy 2 lots of 20 packets for $\$19.00$; save $\$7.00$.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\text{Cost of two lots of 20 packets}&=2\times\$9.50=\$19.00\\\text{Cost of 40 individual packets}&=40\times\$0.65=\$26.00\\\text{Saving}&=\$26.00-\$19.00=\$7.00\end{align*}$$
Buying two lots of 20 packets is cheaper.
